result.summary: The page appears mostly well-formed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, restaurant cards, and bottom navigation are all rendering correctly. Only a minor visual issue was found in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab label and icon in the bottom navigation appear noticeably faded/dimmer compared to the other inactive tabs ('Search' and 'Profile'), creating inconsistent inactive-state styling
issues.suggestion: Ensure inactive tab icons/text have sufficient opacity or contrast so they are clearly readable
